mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shipments WHERE order_id = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE shipments SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirm_source = #{source}, confirmed_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{shipmentId} AND status = 'SHIPPED'
mapper.select: SELECT shipment.id FROM shipments shipment JOIN orders order_head ON order_head.id = shipment.order_id WHERE shipment.status = 'SHIPPED' AND shipment.auto_confirm_at <= #{now} AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(attempt.amount), 0) FROM after_sale_cases sale JOIN refund_attempts attempt ON attempt.case_id = sale.id AND attempt.status = 'SUCCESS' WHERE sale.order_id = shipment.order_id) < order_head.total_amount ORDER BY shipment.auto_confirm_at, shipment.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, shipment.auto_confirm_at, #{now}) FROM shipments shipment JOIN orders order_head ON order_head.id = shipment.order_id WHERE shipment.status = 'SHIPPED' AND shipment.auto_confirm_at <= #{now} AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(attempt.amount), 0) FROM after_sale_cases sale JOIN refund_attempts attempt ON attempt.case_id = sale.id AND attempt.status = 'SUCCESS' WHERE sale.order_id = shipment.order_id) < order_head.total_amount ORDER BY shipment.auto_confirm_at, shipment.id LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(attempt.amount), 0) FROM after_sale_cases sale JOIN refund_attempts attempt ON attempt.case_id = sale.id AND attempt.status = 'SUCCESS' WHERE sale.order_id = #{orderId}
